# `array_union`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns an array of the elements in the union of array1 and array2,
without duplicates.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
array_union(array1, array2)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_union, example 1
> SELECT array_union(array(1, 2, 3), array(1, 3, 5));
[1,2,3,5]
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
